The MyoSkeleton is a biomechanical model of the human body by MyoLab with a detailed spine, hands with fingers, anatomical knees and feet with toes. LocoMuJoCo adds one torque actuator per joint. The model is not shipped with LocoMuJoCo: run `loco-mujoco-myomodel-init` once to accept its license and download it.

## Quick start

The registered name of this environment is `MyoSkeleton`. The snippet loads the walking clip of the default dataset, which is downloaded on first use. LAFAN1 and AMASS clips are loaded the same way, see [datasets](../user_guide/datasets.md).

`````{tab-set}
````{tab-item} MuJoCo (CPU)
```python
from loco_mujoco.task_factories import ImitationFactory, DefaultDatasetConf

env, traj = ImitationFactory.make("MyoSkeleton",
                                  default_dataset_conf=DefaultDatasetConf(task="walk"))

# replay the reference motion
env.play_trajectory(n_episodes=3, n_steps_per_episode=500, render=True)
```
````
````{tab-item} MJX (GPU)
```python
import jax

from loco_mujoco.task_factories import ImitationFactory, DefaultDatasetConf

env, traj = ImitationFactory.make("MjxMyoSkeleton",
                                  default_dataset_conf=DefaultDatasetConf(task="walk"))

n_envs = 1024
reset = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_reset, in_axes=(0, None)))
step = jax.jit(jax.vmap(env.mjx_step, in_axes=(0, 0, None)))

keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(0), n_envs)
state = reset(keys, traj)
action = jax.vmap(env.sample_action_space)(keys)
state = step(state, action, traj)
```
````
`````

```{note}
The MyoSkeleton model has to be downloaded once with `loco-mujoco-myomodel-init`, which asks you to accept its license. See [installation](../getting_started/installation.md).
```

## Facts

The numbers describe the environment as it is created with its default arguments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Registered name | `MyoSkeleton` |
| MJX variant | `MjxMyoSkeleton` |
| Type | Human model |
| Joints (without the floating base) | 151 |
| Degrees of freedom (without the floating base) | 151 |
| Size of `qpos` / `qvel` | 158 / 157 |
| Actuators | 151 (torque) |
| Action dimension | 151 |
| Default control type | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.default.DefaultControl` |
| Observation dimension | 313 |
| Simulation time step (MuJoCo) | 1 ms, 10 substeps per step |
| Control frequency (MuJoCo) | 100 Hz |
| Simulation time step (MJX) | 2 ms, 5 substeps per step |
| Control frequency (MJX) | 100 Hz |
| Mimic sites | 15 |
| Motion capture data | Default, LAFAN1, AMASS |
| Model file | `myoskeleton/myoskeleton.xml` |

## Constructor options

These keyword arguments are specific to this embodiment. They can be passed to the constructor or to a [task factory](../user_guide/task_factories.md), which forwards them.

| Argument | Default | Description | Effect of the other value |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disable_fingers` | `True` | Flag meant to remove the finger joints (see `finger_and_hand_joints`) from the model. | `False`: same spaces |
| `mjx_reduced_contacts` | `True` | Only used by the MJX variant. If True, the collision model is reduced to the contacts between the feet and the floor, which makes MJX much faster. Set it to False to keep the collision geometries of the model. |  |

All environments also accept `spec`, `observation_spec` and `actuation_spec` to replace the model, the observation space and the set of actuators, and the arguments of {class}`~loco_mujoco.environments.base.LocoEnv` and {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.mujoco_base.Mujoco`, such as `timestep`, `n_substeps`, `reward_type`, `control_type` or `terrain_type`. See the [modular architecture](../user_guide/modular_architecture.md).

## Observation space

The default observation has 313 dimensions: the pose of the floating base without its horizontal position, the joint positions, the velocity of the floating base and the joint velocities. A task factory may append further entries; {class}`~loco_mujoco.task_factories.rl_factory.RLFactory`, for example, adds the velocity goal. See [observations](../user_guide/observations.md) for how to change the observation space.

| Index | Name | Observation type | Dim | Model element |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0–4 | `q_free_joint` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.FreeJointPosNoXY` | 5 | `myoskeleton_root` |
| 5–155 | `q_all_pos` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.JointPosArray` | 151 |  |
| 156–161 | `dq_free_joint` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.FreeJointVel` | 6 | `myoskeleton_root` |
| 162–312 | `dq_all_vel` | {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.observations.base.JointVelArray` | 151 |  |

## Action space

The action has 151 dimensions, one per actuator, each in [-1, 1]. The default control type, {class}`~loco_mujoco.core.control_functions.default.DefaultControl`, maps this interval linearly to the control range of each actuator, so an action is a normalized actuator command. Another [control function](../user_guide/control_functions.md) can be selected with `control_type`.
